readout_other: Essential Tremor Rating Assessment Scale (TETRAS: ADL and Performance subscales); Global Rating of Change (GRC)
direction_notes: Study assessed clinical tremor severity (TETRAS) and global rating of change, not neurophysiological excitation/inhibition; TETRAS scores decreased (improved) in all 10 patients.
safety_notes: No adverse events or serious adverse events were reported.

target.label: ventral intermediate nucleus of the thalamus (Vim)

timing.protocol_description: Participants underwent eight, 10-min focused ultrasound sessions, prescribed to be completed over the course of one week. LIFU was administered 30 s on and 30 s off for 10 min as described in Refs. [19,20].

source_quotes.n_subjects: All patients enrolled in the open-label study (June 2022–September 2023) presented with a diagnosis of ET. All patients demonstrated a prominent action tremor and no bradykinesia or rigidity. Ten patients $( M _ { a g e } = 7 3 . 6 0$ years old, 4 females) (Supplementary Table 1) were enrolled and completed the study protocol. Concomitant or concurrent interventions were not considered exclusionary.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The study utilized the Brainsonix Pulsar 1002 to deliver lowintensity focused ultrasound pulses to the Vim. Participants underwent eight, 10-min focused ultrasound sessions, prescribed to be completed over the course of one week. Sonication parameters were set within FDA exposure limits, with a fundamental frequency fixed at 650 kHz, pulse width of 5 ms, duty cycle of 5 %, a pulse repetition frequency of 10 Hz, I<sub>SPPA.3</sub> of 14.39 W/cm2, I<sub>SPTA.3</sub> of 719.73 mW/cm2, Mechanical Index of 0.75 and Peak Negative Pressure of 0.61 MPa. LIFU was administered 30 s on and 30 s off for 10 min as described in Refs. [19,20].

flags.reason: Domain of the reported pressure/intensity values (water vs in-brain) is not stated by the paper; recorded as unspecified_domain.
Paper reports only clinical tremor scales (TETRAS, GRC), no neurophysiological measure of excitation/inhibition, so direction could not be assessed.
Open-label single-arm design; paper does not use the word randomised, inferred false.
